title: Handheld Spray Gun – for Paint & Crafts
descriptionHtml:
Easy spray painting for small projects

Painting small craft projects with a brush easily leaves streaks and an uneven surface. A large spraying rig is both expensive and unnecessary for the small jobs.

Easy to hold and use

This handheld spray gun sits well in the hand and gives an even coat of paint on crafts and smaller surfaces. It's made of durable plastic and is easy to wipe clean.

Features

  • Gives an even coat on small surfaces
  • Ergonomic grip
  • Durable plastic construction
  • Good for crafts, models and hobby projects
  • Easy to clean after use

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
